item.title: Word of the Day: Shibboleth
item.description: Phonetic: /shib·bo·leth/Part of Speech: NounDefinition: a custom, principle, or belief distinguishing a particular class or group of people, especially a long-standing one regarded as outmoded or no longer important. “He is a highly competent and experienced officer who has shown a willingness to challenge shibboleths within the Navy and defence establishment.”
